sec: Relations, fetal zone and definitive zone · p838

items.q: Match adrenal relations — 1) Right gland anterior  2) Right gland posterior  3) Left gland anterior  4) Left gland posterior … A) Right crus of diaphragm  B) Stomach, pancreas, spleen  C) IVC and right liver lobe  D) Left crus of diaphragm
items.exp: Right anterior: IVC + right liver lobe; right posterior: right crus; left anterior: stomach, pancreas, spleen; left posterior: left crus. (Book p838)

items.q: The principal hormone of the fetal zone is:
items.exp: The fetal zone's principal hormone in fetal life is DHEAS; the zone regresses after birth. (Book p838)

items.q: ‘The fetal zone of the adrenal cortex persists and enlarges after birth.’
opts: True — it becomes the zona fasciculata
items.exp: The fetal zone regresses after birth. (Book p838)

items.q: Match definitive zone to hormone and regulator — 1) Zona glomerulosa  2) Zona fasciculata  3) Zona reticularis … A) Cortisol, pituitary  B) DHEAS, pituitary  C) Aldosterone, RAAS
items.exp: ZG → aldosterone under RAAS; ZF → cortisol under pituitary; ZR → DHEAS under pituitary. (Book p838)

items.q: The zona fasciculata contributes what share of the cortex?
Match zone to cortical contribution — 1) Zona glomerulosa  2) Zona fasciculata  3) Zona reticularis … A) 10%  B) 15%  C) 75%
The zona reticularis forms by ___ of age (unlike the other zones, present at birth).
items.exp: ZG and ZF are formed at birth; ZR forms by 2–3 years. (Book p838)

items.q: Adrenarche — pubic and axillary hair growth from the zona reticularis — begins at:
items.exp: Adrenarche occurs at 6–8 years and regresses post reproductive age. (Book p838)

items.q: Maximum daily DHEAS production by the zona reticularis exceeds:
items.exp: DHEAS is produced max daily >20 mg by the zona reticularis. (Book p838)

items.q: On histology, the ‘large lipid-rich clear cells’ belong to the:
items.exp: The zona fasciculata shows large lipid-rich clear cells. (Book p838)
